## How I work
- Automate > operate. Rule of two: any manual report or task done more than twice becomes a spec-driven pipeline.
- Reliability as a product. Downtime is measured by real user impact, not by ticket closure; blameless post-mortems; least-privilege runbooks.
- State outside the code. IDs, cut-offs and thresholds live in configuration (JSON / Notion) read alike by the workflow and the dashboard; the spec is the contract.
- Cursor over ingestion, not the clock. Designed for failure (missed runs, late data), not for the happy path.
- Spec-Driven Development (proposal → specs → design → tasks → apply → archive); the spec is the source of truth. AI as SDLC copilot: spec generation, static code analysis, automated debugging, RCA/post-mortems, documentation, AI Skills (e.g. ticket routing with human review on low confidence).
- Operational SLAs: first response under 10 minutes, critical resolution under 2 hours.

## Experience
- Podemos Progresar (Jul 2026 – present) — Service Support Tech Lead & AI Specialist (fintech / microfinance). Coordinates the Service Support team (bugs, critical incidents, technical debt) and applied Spec-Driven Development with the Claude API to the diagnosis → implementation flow to speed up reviews. Takes part in reshaping the post-mortem process (P0–P3, 5 Whys, blameless) with a tracking board for delays, escalations and progress against target. Calculates and keeps the monthly uptime/downtime record (fleet × real minutes; downtime = real user impact) under the methodology defined by leadership; standardizes runbooks and least-privilege access. Automates part of operations with n8n: Freshdesk → Notion → Slack, post-mortem delay watcher and ticket-spike alerts. Uses AI (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) for specs, analysis, debugging and documentation, and is building an AI Skill that classifies and routes tickets with human review when confidence is low. Takes part in the weekly release trains coordinated by Engineering, validating deployments from Service Support across core banking, origination and field-app platforms. Diagnoses and operates AWS (CloudWatch Logs Insights, RDS) and reviews error tracking in Sentry, using the diagnosis and post-deployment skills built by the infrastructure lead to detect post-deploy errors and estimate impact. SLA targets: first response under 10 minutes, critical resolution under 2 hours.

## Featured projects
- platform-STALD — educational web platform (portal, weekly online activities and exams, real-time multiplayer games) built end-to-end with Spec-Driven Development and Claude Code as an agentic-engineering showcase. Agent tooling: read-only reviewer and test-verifier subagents, 14 skills (domain workflows such as preparing the weekly class), and a PreToolUse hook that blocks committing secrets and pushing to main. Engineering (cut-off 2026-11-02): 250+ merged PRs, 85+ archived OpenSpec changes, 130+ Deno unit-test files in CI (tests, type-check, lint) plus 80+ local E2E flows, health watchdog every 30 min via GitHub Actions. Stack: Deno Deploy, TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth, Realtime), vanilla JS, GitHub Pages. No student data is published. Code: https://github.com/jalducin/platform-STALD
- Fidello — Loyalty Card System: multi-business digital loyalty (stamps via QR, nothing to install); five actors (guest, registered customer, cashier, owner/manager, platform admin), multi-business wallet, tiers and redemptions, self-service business onboarding, KPIs/analytics, satisfaction surveys, scheduled monthly platform report (pg_cron). All business rules in PostgreSQL: multi-tenant RLS, RPC in PL/pgSQL SECURITY DEFINER, QR tokens with TTL + SHA-256 fingerprint (anti-replay), rate limiting on anonymous functions, PII-free audit log, feature flags (global + per-business). Engineering: 793 tests (337 DB against real Postgres + 456 UI), 91 SQL migrations, 22 tables, 7 Edge Functions, 5 cron jobs, 97 OpenSpec changes, 28 journeys with twin runbooks, CI with 2 blocking jobs (frontend + DB), QAS/PROD environments, architecture review package for external reviewers. 100% SDD/OpenSpec with 5 specialized AI agents. Stack: React 18, TypeScript, Vite 5, Tailwind 3, React Router 7, PWA (Workbox), WCAG AA, html5-qrcode, Supabase (PostgreSQL 15, Auth, PostgREST, Realtime, Edge Functions/Deno, pg_cron), Vitest + Testing Library + msw + pg harness, ESLint, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Supabase CLI + Docker. Private repository (demo on request). Deep dive (problem → approach → architecture → decisions → result): /blog/deep-dive-fidello.html
- VoltGrid — multi-tenant, white-label SaaS for EV charging-station operators: live status over WebSocket, tenant isolation via PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS), RBAC (superadmin/org_admin/operator/viewer) + SSO (OIDC), analytics (uptime, kWh, CSV export), auditable state scheduler and installable PWA. 100% SDD. Code: https://github.com/jalducin/voltgrid. Stack: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0 async, asyncpg, Alembic, PostgreSQL 16 (RLS), Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind, WebSockets, Docker, Kubernetes (Kustomize), GitHub Actions.
- Trackion — white-label serverless help desk: end-to-end ticketing, admin-managed catalogs and an open API-integration module (generic inbound webhooks + outbound domain-event dispatch). Grafana tickets & SLA dashboards. Built with SDD; runs locally via Docker. Code: https://github.com/jalducin/Trackion. Stack: Python 3.12, AWS Lambda, API Gateway (HTTP API), Serverless Framework, PostgreSQL (pg8000), JWT (PyJWT), SSM Parameter Store, Grafana, vanilla JS.
- Monitoreo-Cloud — self-hosted observability stack (Grafana + Docker) over three sources: AWS serverless (Lambda/S3 via CloudWatch), local Docker containers, and Trackion's tickets/SLA. Automated collection with n8n + a read-only IAM role. SDD. Code: https://github.com/jalducin/monitoreo-cloud. Stack: Grafana, Docker, n8n, PostgreSQL, AWS CloudWatch, Lambda, S3.
- dataMasterGK — retail ETL middleware that automates master-data integration into GK Software: watches directories, transforms Excel → GK XML (stores, operators, promotions) and transmits via SFTP/FTP, with a Flask web panel (config/operation/audit), scheduler and SQLite auditing. Re-engineered under SDD (idempotent single-pass pipeline, pooled SFTP/SQLite connections, security hardening). Code: https://github.com/jalducin/dataMasterGK. Stack: Python 3.12, Flask, Pandas, openpyxl, SQLite, Paramiko (SFTP), Jinja2.
